skill_name: Suggest a way to store customer data securely
workflow: In order to store customer data securely, the data should be encrypted using strong cryptographic algorithms, such as Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) or Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA). Additionally, the data should be stored on secure servers with access limited to authorized personnel only. Furthermore, the data should also be backed up regularly to prevent loss.
